𝗦𝗟 𝟭𝟲𝟳/𝟱, 𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗟𝗟 𝟲𝟬 𝗕𝗘𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗗! 🇱🇰

Sri Lanka were 167/5 at Day 3 lunch in Rawalpindi, trailing Pakistan's 325 by 60 runs (they were bowled out for 98 in the 1st innings).

Can SL make Pakistan bat again? 👇
